definitions.gloss: made of iron; made of steel; iron-made
definitions.explanation: Describes something manufactured from iron or steel. Used as a modifier with の to describe objects.

examples.japanese: この{門|もん}は{鉄製|てっせい}だ。
examples.english: This gate is made of iron.

examples.japanese: {鉄製|てっせい}のフライパンは{熱|ねつ}の{伝|つた}わりがいい。
examples.english: Iron frying pans conduct heat well.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}い{鉄製|てっせい}の{橋|はし}が{錆|さ}びて{老朽化|ろうきゅうか}が{進|すす}んでいるため、{架|か}け{替|か}えが{検討|けんとう}されている。
examples.english: The old iron bridge has rusted and deteriorated, so replacement is being considered.

notes:
USAGE: {鉄製|てっせい} follows the productive pattern of material + {製|せい} (made of). It is used as a noun or as a modifier with の.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鉄製|てっせい}の{鍋|なべ} (iron pot)
- {鉄製|てっせい}のフライパン (iron frying pan)
- {鉄製|てっせい}の{門|もん} (iron gate)
- {鉄製|てっせい}の{柵|さく} (iron fence)

RELATED PATTERNS: The {製|せい} suffix is extremely productive. Other common examples include {木製|もくせい} (wooden), {金属製|きんぞくせい} (metal), {銅製|どうせい} (copper), {革製|かわせい} (leather), and {手製|てせい} (handmade).
